items.title: Pay 'processing fee' to unlock claimed refund
items.quote: Damit wir sie auszahlen können, überweisen Sie bitte die einmalige Bearbeitungsgebühr von 49,90 € bis zum 27.11.2026 auf das Konto IBAN CY17 0020 0128 0000 0012 0052 7600.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for payment: 27.11.2026 (a Friday, not a weekend or public holiday in NW, so no adjustment applies). This is the date printed in the letter as written.

warnings: This letter shows strong hallmarks of an advance-fee scam: it asks the recipient to pay a 'processing fee' before releasing a much larger promised refund, a classic fraud pattern.

The payment IBAN (CY17...) is a Cypriot account; no genuine German energy-cost refund scheme (there is no official body called 'Verbraucher-Rückerstattungsstelle Energie') would require payment to a foreign account to release money owed to a consumer.
There is artificial time pressure and a threat that the claim 'verfällt endgültig' (is permanently forfeited) if the short deadline is missed — a typical scam pressure tactic.
The sender's address is in Nicosia, Zypern, which is inconsistent with a German consumer protection or refund authority; no real German energy provider or Behörde is identified by name.
Recommendation: do not transfer any money and do not reply with personal or bank data; this letter should be treated as fraudulent and reported/ignored rather than acted upon.
